1Ch.16.24.kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.

1Ch.29.3.kjv: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

1Ch.29.15.bsb: For we are foreigners and strangers in Your presence, as were all our forefathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.
1Ch.29.15.kjv: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.

1Ch.21.16.bsb: When David lifted up his eyes and saw the angel of the LORD standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem, David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.
1Ch.21.16.kjv: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

1Ch.4.10.bsb: And Jabez called out to the God of Israel, “If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted the request of Jabez.
1Ch.4.10.kjv: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

1Ch.29.10.bsb: Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of all the assembly and said: “May You be blessed, O LORD, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
1Ch.29.10.kjv: Wherefore David blessed the Lord before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, Lord God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

1Ch.29.11.bsb: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
1Ch.29.11.kjv: Thine, O Lord, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Lord, and thou art exalted as head above all.

1Ch.29.12.bsb: Both riches and honor come from You, and You are the ruler over all. In Your hands are power and might to exalt and give strength to all.
1Ch.29.12.kjv: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

1Ch.29.13.bsb: Now therefore, our God, we give You thanks, and we praise Your glorious name.
1Ch.29.13.kjv: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

1Ch.29.14.bsb: But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? For everything comes from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You.
1Ch.29.14.kjv: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

1Ch.29.16.bsb: O LORD our God, from Your hand comes all this abundance that we have provided to build You a house for Your holy Name, and all of it belongs to You.
1Ch.29.16.kjv: O Lord our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.

1Ch.29.17.bsb: I know, my God, that You test the heart and delight in uprightness. All these things I have given willingly and with an upright heart, and now I have seen Your people who are present here giving joyfully and willingly to You.
1Ch.29.17.kjv: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.

1Ch.29.18.bsb: O LORD, God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, keep this desire forever in the intentions of the hearts of Your people, and direct their hearts toward You.
1Ch.29.18.kjv: O Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

1Ch.29.19.bsb: And give my son Solomon a whole heart to keep and carry out all Your commandments, decrees, and statutes, and to build Your palace for which I have made provision.”
1Ch.29.19.kjv: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

1Ch.29.29.kjv: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

1Ch.16.21.bsb: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
1Ch.16.21.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

1Ch.16.22.bsb: ‘Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!’
1Ch.16.22.kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

1Ch.25.5.bsb: All these sons of Heman the king’s seer were given him through the promises of God to exalt him, for God had given Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
1Ch.25.5.kjv: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

1Ch.25.6.bsb: All these were under the direction of their fathers for the music of the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the direction of the king.
1Ch.25.6.kjv: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king’s order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

1Ch.22.10.bsb: He is the one who will build a house for My Name. He will be My son, and I will be his Father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
1Ch.22.10.kjv: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

1Ch.28.6.bsb: And He said to me, ‘Solomon your son is the one who will build My house and My courts, for I have chosen him as My son, and I will be his Father.
1Ch.28.6.kjv: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

1Ch.21.15.bsb: Then God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem, but as the angel was doing so, the LORD saw it and relented from the calamity, and He said to the angel who was destroying the people, “Enough! Withdraw your hand now!” At that time the angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
1Ch.21.15.kjv: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the Lord beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

1Ch.21.18.bsb: Then the angel of the LORD ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
1Ch.21.18.kjv: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

1Ch.12.22.bsb: For at that time men came to David day after day to help him, until he had a great army, like the army of God.
1Ch.12.22.kjv: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.

1Ch.20.3.bsb: David brought out the people who were there and put them to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. And he did the same to all the Ammonite cities. Then David and all his troops returned to Jerusalem.
1Ch.20.3.kjv: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

1Ch.22.12.bsb: Above all, may the LORD give you insight and understanding when He puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God.
1Ch.22.12.kjv: Only the Lord give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the Lord thy God.

1Ch.24.5.bsb: Thus they were divided by lot, for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among both Eleazar’s and Ithamar’s descendants.

1Ch.6.31.bsb: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark rested there.
1Ch.6.31.kjv: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after that the ark had rest.

1Ch.22.1.bsb: Then David said, “Here shall be the house of the LORD God, as well as the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
1Ch.22.1.kjv: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

1Ch.22.11.bsb: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would.
1Ch.22.11.kjv: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as he hath said of thee.

1Ch.22.14.bsb: Now behold, I have taken great pains to provide for the house of the LORD—100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, and bronze and iron too great to be weighed. I have also provided timber and stone, and you may add to them.
1Ch.22.14.kjv: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the Lord an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

1Ch.23.4.bsb: “Of these,” said David, “24,000 are to oversee the work of the house of the LORD, 6,000 are to be officers and judges,

1Ch.26.12.kjv: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the Lord.

1Ch.9.29.bsb: Others were put in charge of the furnishings and other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.
1Ch.9.29.kjv: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

1Ch.22.19.bsb: Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God. Begin building the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy articles of God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD.”
1Ch.22.19.kjv: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.

1Ch.28.10.bsb: Consider now that the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong and do it.”
1Ch.28.10.kjv: Take heed now; for the Lord hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.

1Ch.23.32.kjv: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the Lord.

1Ch.17.11.bsb: And when your days are fulfilled and you go to be with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
1Ch.17.11.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

1Ch.17.12.bsb: He will build a house for Me, and I will establish his throne forever.
1Ch.17.12.kjv: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

1Ch.17.13.bsb: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. And I will never remove My loving devotion from him as I removed it from your predecessor.
1Ch.17.13.kjv: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:

1Ch.17.14.bsb: But I will set him over My house and My kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.”
1Ch.17.14.kjv: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

1Ch.20.2.bsb: Then David took the crown from the head of their king. It was found to weigh a talent of gold and was set with precious stones, and it was placed on David’s head. And David took a great amount of plunder from the city.
1Ch.20.2.kjv: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

1Ch.10.13.bsb: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the LORD, because he did not keep the word of the LORD and even consulted a medium for guidance,
1Ch.10.13.kjv: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, even against the word of the Lord, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;

1Ch.10.14.bsb: and he failed to inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
1Ch.10.14.kjv: And enquired not of the Lord: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.

1Ch.26.26.bsb: This Shelomith and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and by the army commanders.
1Ch.26.26.kjv: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.

1Ch.26.27.bsb: They had dedicated some of the plunder from their battles to the repair of the house of the LORD.
1Ch.26.27.kjv: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the Lord.

1Ch.28.20.bsb: David also said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will neither fail you nor forsake you before all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.
1Ch.28.20.kjv: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the Lord God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord.

1Ch.5.20.bsb: And because they cried out to God in battle, they were helped against their enemies, and the Hagrites and all their allies were delivered into their hands. Because they put their trust in God, He answered their prayers.
1Ch.5.20.kjv: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

1Ch.16.26.bsb: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
1Ch.16.26.kjv: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

1Ch.16.36.bsb: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.” Then all the people said, “Amen!” and “Praise the LORD!”
1Ch.16.36.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord.

1Ch.17.27.bsb: So now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O LORD, have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever.”
1Ch.17.27.kjv: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O Lord, and it shall be blessed for ever.

1Ch.16.25.bsb: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
1Ch.16.25.kjv: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.

1Ch.16.34.bsb: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
1Ch.16.34.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

1Ch.22.18.bsb: “Is not the LORD your God with you, and has He not granted you rest on every side? For He has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land has been subdued before the LORD and His people.
1Ch.22.18.kjv: Is not the Lord your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.

1Ch.16.10.bsb: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
1Ch.16.10.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

1Ch.16.33.bsb: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for He is coming to judge the earth.
1Ch.16.33.kjv: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the Lord, because he cometh to judge the earth.

1Ch.28.9.bsb: As for you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches every heart and understands the intent of every thought. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever.
1Ch.28.9.kjv: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the Lord searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

1Ch.11.13.bsb: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At a place with a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.
1Ch.11.13.kjv: He was with David at Pas–dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

1Ch.11.14.bsb: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it. They struck down the Philistines, and the LORD brought about a great victory.
1Ch.11.14.kjv: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.

1Ch.17.7.bsb: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.
1Ch.17.7.kjv: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

1Ch.17.8.bsb: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make for you a name like that of the greatest in the land.
1Ch.17.8.kjv: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

1Ch.22.9.bsb: But a son will be born to you who will be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side; for his name will be Solomon, and I will grant to Israel peace and quiet during his reign.
1Ch.22.9.kjv: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

1Ch.22.13.bsb: Then you will succeed, if you carefully follow the statutes and ordinances that the LORD commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.
1Ch.22.13.kjv: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the Lord charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

1Ch.28.8.bsb: So now in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, so that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance to your descendants forever.
1Ch.28.8.kjv: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the Lord, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the Lord your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

1Ch.5.26.kjv: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath–pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

1Ch.29.22.bsb: That day they ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the LORD. Then, for a second time, they designated David’s son Solomon as king, anointing him before the LORD as ruler, and Zadok as the priest.
1Ch.29.22.kjv: And did eat and drink before the Lord on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the Lord to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.

1Ch.11.3.kjv: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.

1Ch.28.4.kjv: Howbeit the Lord God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:

1Ch.28.5.kjv: And of all my sons, (for the Lord hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

1Ch.6.29.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

1Ch.6.30.bsb: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.
1Ch.6.30.kjv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

1Ch.23.21.bsb: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
1Ch.23.21.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

1Ch.23.22.bsb: Eleazar died without having any sons; he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.
1Ch.23.22.kjv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

1Ch.23.23.bsb: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth—three in all.
1Ch.23.23.kjv: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

1Ch.9.27.bsb: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they were responsible for guarding it and opening it every morning.
1Ch.9.27.kjv: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

1Ch.9.33.bsb: Those who were musicians, the heads of Levite families, stayed in the temple chambers and were exempt from other duties because they were on duty day and night.
1Ch.9.33.kjv: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.

1Ch.23.3.bsb: The Levites thirty years of age or older were counted, and the total number of men was 38,000.
1Ch.23.3.kjv: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

1Ch.23.24.bsb: These were the descendants of Levi by their families—the heads of families, registered individually by name—those twenty years of age or older who worked in the service of the house of the LORD.
1Ch.23.24.kjv: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and upward.

1Ch.23.27.bsb: For according to the final instructions of David, the Levites twenty years of age or older were counted,
1Ch.23.27.kjv: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:

1Ch.9.28.bsb: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship, to count them whenever they were brought in or taken out.
1Ch.9.28.kjv: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

1Ch.23.2.bsb: Then he gathered all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.
1Ch.23.2.kjv: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

1Ch.23.5.bsb: 4,000 are to be gatekeepers, and 4,000 are to praise the LORD with the instruments I have made for giving praise.”
1Ch.23.5.kjv: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.

1Ch.23.6.bsb: Then David divided the Levites into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
1Ch.23.6.kjv: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

1Ch.23.7.kjv: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.

1Ch.23.8.bsb: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham, and Joel—three in all.
1Ch.23.8.kjv: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

1Ch.23.9.bsb: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.
1Ch.23.9.kjv: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

1Ch.23.10.bsb: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei—four in all.
1Ch.23.10.kjv: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

1Ch.23.11.bsb: Jahath was the first and Zizah was the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they were counted as one family and received a single assignment.
1Ch.23.11.kjv: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father’s house.

1Ch.23.12.bsb: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four in all.
1Ch.23.12.kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

1Ch.23.13.bsb: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were set apart forever to consecrate the most holy things, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister before Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name forever.
1Ch.23.13.kjv: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.

1Ch.23.14.bsb: As for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
1Ch.23.14.kjv: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

1Ch.23.15.bsb: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
1Ch.23.15.kjv: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.

1Ch.23.16.bsb: The descendants of Gershom: Shebuel was the first.
1Ch.23.16.kjv: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.

1Ch.23.17.bsb: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer did not have any other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.
1Ch.23.17.kjv: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

1Ch.23.18.bsb: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.
1Ch.23.18.kjv: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

1Ch.23.19.bsb: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
1Ch.23.19.kjv: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

1Ch.23.20.bsb: The sons of Uzziel: Micah was the first and Isshiah the second.
1Ch.23.20.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.

1Ch.23.25.bsb: For David had said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to His people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever.
1Ch.23.25.kjv: For David said, The Lord God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

1Ch.23.26.bsb: So now the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles for its service.”
1Ch.23.26.kjv: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

1Ch.23.28.bsb: but their duty was to assist the descendants of Aaron with the service of the house of the LORD, being responsible for the courts and chambers, the purification of all the holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God,
1Ch.23.28.kjv: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

1Ch.23.29.bsb: as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baking, the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
1Ch.23.29.kjv: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

1Ch.23.30.bsb: They were also to stand every morning to give thanks and praise to the LORD, and likewise in the evening.
1Ch.23.30.kjv: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at even;

1Ch.23.31.bsb: Whenever burnt offerings were presented to the LORD on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts, they were to serve regularly before the LORD in the numbers prescribed for them.
1Ch.23.31.kjv: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the Lord:

1Ch.15.26.bsb: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
1Ch.15.26.kjv: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

1Ch.15.27.bsb: Now David was dressed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, as well as the singers and Chenaniah, the director of music for the singers. David also wore a linen ephod.
1Ch.15.27.kjv: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

1Ch.16.4.bsb: David appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, to celebrate, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel.
1Ch.16.4.kjv: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to record, and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel:

1Ch.9.26.bsb: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.
1Ch.9.26.kjv: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

1Ch.26.28.bsb: Everything that had been dedicated by Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah, along with everything else that was dedicated, was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers.
1Ch.26.28.kjv: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

1Ch.29.8.bsb: Whoever had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the LORD, under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.
1Ch.29.8.kjv: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the Lord, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

1Ch.26.29.bsb: From the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons had the outside duties as officers and judges over Israel.
1Ch.26.29.kjv: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

1Ch.6.54.bsb: Now these were the territories assigned to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clan for their settlements, because the first lot fell to them:
1Ch.6.54.kjv: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.

1Ch.6.55.bsb: They were given Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands.
1Ch.6.55.kjv: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.

1Ch.6.56.bsb: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
1Ch.6.56.kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

1Ch.6.57.bsb: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
1Ch.6.57.kjv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,

1Ch.6.58.kjv: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,

1Ch.6.59.bsb: Ashan, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.59.kjv: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs:

1Ch.6.60.bsb: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. So they had thirteen cities in all among their families.
1Ch.6.60.kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

1Ch.6.61.bsb: To the rest of the Kohathites, ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
1Ch.6.61.kjv: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

1Ch.6.62.bsb: The Gershomites, according to their clans, were allotted thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
1Ch.6.62.kjv: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

1Ch.6.63.bsb: The Merarites, according to their clans, were allotted twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
1Ch.6.63.kjv: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

1Ch.6.64.bsb: So the Israelites gave to the Levites these cities and their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.64.kjv: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

1Ch.6.65.bsb: They assigned by lot the cities named above from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
1Ch.6.65.kjv: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.

1Ch.6.66.bsb: And some of the clans of the Kohathites were given cities from the tribe of Ephraim for their territory:
1Ch.6.66.kjv: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.

1Ch.6.67.bsb: They were given Shechem (a city of refuge) with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer,
1Ch.6.67.kjv: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,

1Ch.6.68.kjv: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth–horon with her suburbs,

1Ch.6.69.bsb: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.69.kjv: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath–rimmon with her suburbs:

1Ch.6.70.bsb: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh the rest of the clans of the Kohathites were given Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.70.kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.

1Ch.6.71.bsb: The Gershomites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.71.kjv: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:

1Ch.6.72.bsb: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kedesh, Daberath,
1Ch.6.72.kjv: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,

1Ch.6.73.bsb: Ramoth, and Anem, together with their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.73.kjv: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:

1Ch.6.74.bsb: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mashal, Abdon,
1Ch.6.74.kjv: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,

1Ch.6.75.bsb: Hukok, and Rehob, together with their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.75.kjv: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:

1Ch.6.76.bsb: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.76.kjv: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.

1Ch.6.77.bsb: The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.77.kjv: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:

1Ch.6.78.bsb: From the tribe of Reuben east of the Jordan opposite Jericho they were given Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,
1Ch.6.78.kjv: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,

1Ch.6.79.bsb: Kedemoth, and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.79.kjv: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:

1Ch.6.80.bsb: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,
1Ch.6.80.kjv: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

1Ch.6.81.bsb: Heshbon, and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.
1Ch.6.81.kjv: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.

1Ch.13.2.bsb: And he said to the whole assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if this is of the LORD our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our brothers in all the land of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites in their cities and pasturelands, so that they may join us.
1Ch.13.2.kjv: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

1Ch.12.26.kjv: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

1Ch.29.5.bsb: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now who is willing to consecrate himself to the LORD today?”
1Ch.29.5.kjv: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the Lord?

1Ch.17.1.bsb: After David had settled into his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent.”
1Ch.17.1.kjv: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord remaineth under curtains.

1Ch.21.24.bsb: “No,” replied King David, “I insist on paying the full price, for I will not take for the LORD what belongs to you, nor will I offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing.”
1Ch.21.24.kjv: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

1Ch.28.2.bsb: Then King David rose to his feet and said, “Listen to me, my brothers and my people. It was in my heart to build a house as a resting place for the ark of the covenant of the LORD and as a footstool for our God. I had made preparations to build it,
1Ch.28.2.kjv: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

1Ch.29.2.bsb: Now with all my ability I have made provision for the house of my God—gold for the gold articles, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron, and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and slabs of marble—all in abundance.
1Ch.29.2.kjv: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

1Ch.29.4.bsb: three thousand talents of gold (the gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the buildings,
1Ch.29.4.kjv: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:

1Ch.29.6.bsb: Then the leaders of the families, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly.
1Ch.29.6.kjv: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king’s work, offered willingly,

1Ch.29.7.bsb: Toward the service of God’s house they gave 5,000 talents and 10,000 darics of gold, 10,000 talents of silver, 18,000 talents of bronze, and 100,000 talents of iron.
1Ch.29.7.kjv: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

1Ch.29.9.bsb: And the people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders, for they had given to the LORD freely and wholeheartedly. And King David also rejoiced greatly.
1Ch.29.9.kjv: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the Lord: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

1Ch.16.3.bsb: Then he distributed to every man and woman of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.
1Ch.16.3.kjv: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.

1Ch.15.22.bsb: Chenaniah the head Levite was the director of the music because he was highly skilled.
1Ch.15.22.kjv: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

1Ch.25.7.bsb: Together with their relatives, who were all trained and skillful in the songs of the LORD, they numbered 288.
1Ch.25.7.kjv: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the Lord, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.

1Ch.25.8.bsb: They cast lots for their duties, young and old alike, teacher as well as pupil.
1Ch.25.8.kjv: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

1Ch.15.20.bsb: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play the harps according to Alamoth.
1Ch.15.20.kjv: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

1Ch.6.32.bsb: They ministered with song before the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. And they performed their duties according to the regulations given them.
1Ch.6.32.kjv: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.

1Ch.15.16.bsb: David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.
1Ch.15.16.kjv: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

1Ch.15.17.bsb: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his brothers, Asaph son of Berechiah; from their brothers the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
1Ch.15.17.kjv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

1Ch.15.18.bsb: and with them their brothers next in rank: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-edom and Jeiel.
1Ch.15.18.kjv: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed–edom, and Jeiel, the porters.

1Ch.15.19.bsb: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals.
1Ch.15.19.kjv: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

1Ch.15.21.bsb: And Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead the music with lyres according to Sheminith.
1Ch.15.21.kjv: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed–edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

1Ch.15.24.bsb: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer—the priests—were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were also to be guardians of the ark.
1Ch.15.24.kjv: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed–edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

1Ch.15.28.bsb: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.
1Ch.15.28.kjv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

1Ch.16.5.bsb: Asaph was the chief, Zechariah was second, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel. They were to play the harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded the cymbals
1Ch.16.5.kjv: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed–edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

1Ch.16.6.bsb: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
1Ch.16.6.kjv: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

1Ch.16.7.bsb: On that day David first committed to Asaph and his associates this song of thanksgiving to the LORD:
1Ch.16.7.kjv: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the Lord into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

1Ch.16.8.bsb: “Give thanks to the LORD; call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
1Ch.16.8.kjv: Give thanks unto the Lord, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

1Ch.16.9.bsb: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
1Ch.16.9.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.

1Ch.16.11.bsb: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
1Ch.16.11.kjv: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.

1Ch.16.12.bsb: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
1Ch.16.12.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

1Ch.16.13.bsb: O offspring of His servant Israel, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
1Ch.16.13.kjv: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

1Ch.16.14.bsb: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
1Ch.16.14.kjv: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

1Ch.16.15.bsb: Remember His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
1Ch.16.15.kjv: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

1Ch.16.16.bsb: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
1Ch.16.16.kjv: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

1Ch.16.17.bsb: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
1Ch.16.17.kjv: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

1Ch.16.18.bsb: ‘I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.’
1Ch.16.18.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

1Ch.16.19.bsb: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
1Ch.16.19.kjv: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

1Ch.16.20.bsb: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
1Ch.16.20.kjv: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;

1Ch.16.23.bsb: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Proclaim His salvation day after day.
1Ch.16.23.kjv: Sing unto the Lord, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.

1Ch.16.27.bsb: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and joy fill His dwelling.
1Ch.16.27.kjv: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.

1Ch.16.28.bsb: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
1Ch.16.28.kjv: Give unto the Lord, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

1Ch.16.29.bsb: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and come before Him. Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness;
1Ch.16.29.kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

1Ch.16.30.bsb: tremble before Him, all the earth. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
1Ch.16.30.kjv: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

1Ch.16.31.bsb: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice. Let them say among the nations, ‘The LORD reigns!’
1Ch.16.31.kjv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The Lord reigneth.

1Ch.16.32.bsb: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it; let the fields exult, and all that is in them.
1Ch.16.32.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.

1Ch.16.35.bsb: Then cry out: ‘Save us, O God of our salvation; gather and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.’
1Ch.16.35.kjv: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.

1Ch.16.37.bsb: So David left Asaph and his associates there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to minister there regularly according to the daily requirements,
1Ch.16.37.kjv: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:

1Ch.16.38.bsb: along with Obed-edom and his sixty-eight relatives. Obed-edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were to be gatekeepers.
1Ch.16.38.kjv: And Obed–edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed–edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

1Ch.16.39.bsb: And David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon
1Ch.16.39.kjv: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,

1Ch.16.41.bsb: With them were Heman, Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD, for “His loving devotion endures forever.”
1Ch.16.41.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever;

1Ch.16.42.bsb: Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments for the songs of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.
1Ch.16.42.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

1Ch.22.3.bsb: David provided a large quantity of iron to make the nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, together with more bronze than could be weighed
1Ch.22.3.kjv: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

1Ch.22.5.bsb: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death.
1Ch.22.5.kjv: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

1Ch.22.6.bsb: Then David called for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
1Ch.22.6.kjv: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the Lord God of Israel.

1Ch.17.16.bsb: Then King David went in, sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
1Ch.17.16.kjv: And David the king came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

1Ch.17.17.bsb: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O God, You have spoken about the future of the house of Your servant and have regarded me as a man of great distinction, O LORD God.
1Ch.17.17.kjv: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Lord God.

1Ch.17.18.bsb: What more can David say to You for honoring Your servant? For You know Your servant,
1Ch.17.18.kjv: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

1Ch.17.19.bsb: O LORD. For the sake of Your servant and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and made known all these great promises.
1Ch.17.19.kjv: O Lord, for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

1Ch.17.20.bsb: O LORD, there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
1Ch.17.20.kjv: O Lord, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

1Ch.17.21.bsb: And who is like Your people Israel—the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself? You made a name for Yourself through great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before Your people, whom You redeemed from Egypt.
1Ch.17.21.kjv: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

1Ch.17.22.bsb: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
1Ch.17.22.kjv: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, Lord, becamest their God.

1Ch.17.23.bsb: And now, O LORD, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised,
1Ch.17.23.kjv: Therefore now, Lord, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

1Ch.17.24.bsb: so that Your name will be established and magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, is God over Israel.’ And may the house of Your servant David be established before You.
1Ch.17.24.kjv: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

1Ch.17.25.bsb: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build a house for him. Therefore Your servant has found the courage to pray before You.
1Ch.17.25.kjv: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.

1Ch.17.26.bsb: And now, O LORD, You are God! And You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
1Ch.17.26.kjv: And now, Lord, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

1Ch.12.27.bsb: including Jehoiada, leader of the house of Aaron, with 3,700 men,
1Ch.12.27.kjv: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

1Ch.12.28.bsb: and Zadok, a mighty young man of valor, with 22 commanders from his own family.
1Ch.12.28.kjv: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.

1Ch.24.1.bsb: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
1Ch.24.1.kjv: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

1Ch.24.2.bsb: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
1Ch.24.2.kjv: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.

1Ch.24.3.bsb: With the help of Eleazar’s descendant Zadok and Ithamar’s descendant Ahimelech, David divided them according to the offices of their service.
1Ch.24.3.kjv: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

1Ch.24.4.bsb: Since more leaders were found among Eleazar’s descendants than those of Ithamar, they were divided accordingly. There were sixteen heads of families from the descendants of Eleazar and eight from the descendants of Ithamar.
1Ch.24.4.kjv: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

1Ch.24.6.bsb: The scribe, Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officers: Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of families of the priests and the Levites—one family being taken from Eleazar, and then one from Ithamar.
1Ch.24.6.kjv: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

1Ch.24.7.bsb: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
1Ch.24.7.kjv: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

1Ch.24.8.bsb: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
1Ch.24.8.kjv: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

1Ch.24.9.bsb: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
1Ch.24.9.kjv: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

1Ch.24.10.bsb: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
1Ch.24.10.kjv: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

1Ch.24.11.bsb: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
1Ch.24.11.kjv: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

1Ch.24.12.bsb: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
1Ch.24.12.kjv: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

1Ch.24.13.bsb: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
1Ch.24.13.kjv: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

1Ch.24.14.bsb: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
1Ch.24.14.kjv: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

1Ch.24.15.bsb: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
1Ch.24.15.kjv: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

1Ch.24.16.bsb: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
1Ch.24.16.kjv: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

1Ch.24.17.bsb: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
1Ch.24.17.kjv: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

1Ch.24.18.bsb: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
1Ch.24.18.kjv: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.

1Ch.24.19.bsb: This was their appointed order for service when they entered the house of the LORD, according to the regulations prescribed for them by their forefather Aaron, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
1Ch.24.19.kjv: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.

1Ch.28.13.bsb: for the divisions of the priests and Levites, for all the work of service in the house of the LORD, and for all the articles of service in the house of the LORD:
1Ch.28.13.kjv: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the Lord.

1Ch.28.21.bsb: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the service of the house of God, and every willing man of every skill will be at your disposal for the work. The officials and all the people are fully at your command.”
1Ch.28.21.kjv: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.

1Ch.16.40.bsb: to regularly present burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offerings, morning and evening, according to all that was written in the Law of the LORD, which He had commanded Israel to keep.
1Ch.16.40.kjv: To offer burnt offerings unto the Lord upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel;

1Ch.9.10.bsb: From the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin;
1Ch.9.10.kjv: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

1Ch.9.12.bsb: Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
1Ch.9.12.kjv: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

1Ch.9.13.bsb: and 1,760 of their relatives, the heads of their families, able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
1Ch.9.13.kjv: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

1Ch.9.22.bsb: The number of those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds was 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their positions of trust.
1Ch.9.22.kjv: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

1Ch.12.18.bsb: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, the chief of the Thirty, and he said: “We are yours, O David! We are with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, for your God helps you.” So David received them and made them leaders of his troops.
1Ch.12.18.kjv: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

1Ch.28.19.bsb: “All this,” said David, “all the details of this plan, the LORD has made clear to me in writing by His hand upon me.”
1Ch.28.19.kjv: All this, said David, the Lord made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.

1Ch.4.9.bsb: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
1Ch.4.9.kjv: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

1Ch.21.17.bsb: And David said to God, “Was it not I who gave the order to count the people? I am the one who has sinned and acted wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? O LORD my God, please let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house, but do not let this plague remain upon Your people.”
1Ch.21.17.kjv: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O Lord my God, be on me, and on my father’s house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.

1Ch.2.34.bsb: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. He also had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
1Ch.2.34.kjv: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

1Ch.2.35.bsb: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
1Ch.2.35.kjv: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

1Ch.21.29.bsb: For the tabernacle of the LORD that Moses had made in the wilderness and the altar of burnt offering were presently at the high place in Gibeon,
1Ch.21.29.kjv: For the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

1Ch.15.1.bsb: David constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
1Ch.15.1.kjv: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

1Ch.16.1.bsb: So they brought the ark of God and placed it inside the tent that David had pitched for it. And they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
1Ch.16.1.kjv: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

1Ch.16.2.bsb: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
1Ch.16.2.kjv: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.

1Ch.29.1.bsb: Then King David said to the whole assembly, “My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great because this palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
1Ch.29.1.kjv: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.

1Ch.22.7.bsb: “My son,” said David to Solomon, “it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God,
1Ch.22.7.kjv: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God:

1Ch.22.8.bsb: but this word of the LORD came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.
1Ch.22.8.kjv: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

1Ch.28.3.bsb: but God said to me, ‘You are not to build a house for My Name, because you are a man of war who has shed blood.’
1Ch.28.3.kjv: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.

1Ch.28.14.bsb: the weight of all the gold articles for every kind of service; the weight of all the silver articles for every kind of service;
1Ch.28.14.kjv: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

1Ch.28.15.bsb: the weight of the gold lampstands and their lamps, including the weight of each lampstand and its lamps; the weight of each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;
1Ch.28.15.kjv: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

1Ch.28.16.bsb: the weight of gold for each table of showbread, and of silver for the silver tables;
1Ch.28.16.kjv: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:

1Ch.28.17.bsb: the weight of the pure gold for the forks, sprinkling bowls, and pitchers; the weight of each gold dish; the weight of each silver bowl;
1Ch.28.17.kjv: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:

1Ch.28.18.bsb: the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense; and the plans for the chariot of the gold cherubim that spread their wings and overshadowed the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
1Ch.28.18.kjv: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

1Ch.21.28.bsb: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.
1Ch.21.28.kjv: At that time when David saw that the Lord had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

1Ch.21.30.bsb: but David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
1Ch.21.30.kjv: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.

1Ch.10.9.bsb: They stripped Saul, cut off his head, took his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.
1Ch.10.9.kjv: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.

1Ch.10.10.bsb: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of Dagon.
1Ch.10.10.kjv: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

1Ch.9.1.bsb: So all Israel was recorded in the genealogies written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. But Judah was exiled to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
1Ch.9.1.kjv: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

1Ch.2.7.bsb: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
1Ch.2.7.kjv: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

1Ch.5.25.bsb: But they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and they prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

1Ch.2.30.kjv: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

1Ch.2.16.bsb: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.

1Ch.19.10.kjv: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

1Ch.21.4.bsb: Nevertheless, the king’s word prevailed against Joab. So Joab departed and traveled throughout Israel, and then he returned to Jerusalem.
1Ch.21.4.kjv: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

1Ch.2.48.kjv: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

1Ch.2.49.kjv: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

1Ch.4.15.kjv: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.

1Ch.7.38.kjv: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

1Ch.4.19.kjv: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

1Ch.5.3.kjv: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

1Ch.12.33.kjv: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.

1Ch.26.17.bsb: Each day there were six Levites on the east, four on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.

1Ch.7.37.bsb: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
1Ch.7.37.kjv: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

1Ch.8.27.kjv: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

1Ch.12.7.kjv: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

1Ch.9.30.kjv: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

1Ch.11.18.kjv: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth–lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the Lord,

1Ch.19.18.kjv: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

1Ch.1.9.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

1Ch.1.46.kjv: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

1Ch.1.47.bsb: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
1Ch.1.47.kjv: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

1Ch.1.50.kjv: And when Baal–hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

1Ch.1.43.kjv: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

1Ch.1.54.bsb: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
